role: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY — no training decision without its own preregistration
generation_realization_gap: 19 targets where gold ranked #1 under full-sequence scoring yet free greedy emitted something else

failure_taxonomy_n75.note: novel codes are composed on the fly, not memorized: zero of 25 distinct novel codes appear anywhere in the training data

token_level_anatomy_n74_parsed.interpretation: the dominant failure is at or before the 3-letter prefix token of the code; when the prefix IS right, the digits still get corrupted more often than not

gold_candidate_rank_among_all_75_failure.conclusion: 75 failures = 19 pure realization failures + 56 selection failures. The PRIMARY bottleneck remains SELECTION (75%), with a secondary realization deficit (25%)

refined_conclusion: Three distinct regimes now measured on the same frozen child: (1) SELECTED AND REALIZED: 44/119 (37%). (2) SELECTION FAILURE: 56/119 (47%) - gold not ranked #1 and greedy also wrong. (3) REALIZATION FAILURE: 19/119 (16%) - correct value ranked #1 but free decode emitted a different, well-formed, on-the-fly-composed code (never memorized). The realization failures are NOT first-token failures: the leading-space token is always emitted correctly. The competition lives at the code-prefix token (3-letter group) and digit tokens.
implication_for_next_experiment: A margin objective targeting candidate ranking would address regime (2). Regime (3) needs decode-time competition pressure instead - e.g. training-time exposure to the 'commit to the selected code' step, or an output format that shortens the realized sequence. Both require their own preregistration; neither is justified to start without measuring which regime a proposed objective actually claims to fix.
